# A test's read of a window's menu reads its items, each item's @select with
# them, and one of those calls a method through a node the window holds: the
# Pokédex's menu asking for the Pokédexes again. The read copies the call
# into the test, which pointed it at the method's clone on the Model and
# handed it the node's instance besides -- `c.refresh__inst0(c.app)`, too
# many arguments and a field the Model does not hold, on fyne, gtk4 and
# bubbletea -- where the program's own call of the clone hands it nothing.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import async "sngl:async"
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

func look(k string, life async.Lifetime) async.Result[string] {
    return {ok=k}
}

// A request with a method of its own, as an adapter openapi writes is.
component lister(:failure option[async.Failure] = null, @loaded(v string)) ui.node {
    async.query #ask(on="a", fetch=look, :failure=failure, @load(v) { loaded(v) })

    func refresh() {
        ask.refresh()
    }
}

component App root {
    var loads = 0
    var failure option[async.Failure] = null
    var picked = ""

    ui.window #main(title="App") {
        component menu {
            ui.menuItem(label="Lists") {
                if failure != null {
                    ui.menuItem(label="Again", @select { dexesAsk.refresh() })
                }
                ui.menuItem(label="One", checked=picked == "one", @select { picked = "one" })
            }
        }
        lister #dexesAsk(:failure=failure, @loaded(v) { loads = loads + 1 })
        ui.text("{loads}")
    }
}

component shell root {
    App #app
}

// A read of a window's menu reads its items, each item's @select with them,
// one of which calls through a node the window holds.
func testAMenuReachesItsNode(t test.Test, c shell) {
    t.wait(func() => c.app.loads == 1, 2000)
    c.app.main.menu[0].select()
    c.app.main.menu[0].children[0].select()
    t.assert(c.app.main.menu[0].children[0].checked)
}
